repository_acquisition.objective: Follow open-kernel-driver-port/references/acquisition.md for version selection. Choose exactly one source, target and QEMU upstream repository/ref for the frozen envelope, inspecting supplied_upstream_baselines, supplied_local_repositories and metadata only. When a role has a supplied_local_repositories path, choose a ref that is expected to exist in that local Git repository because that role will be acquired strictly offline; do not assume the controller can fall back to a remote. Do not clone, fetch, resolve tags or write provenance; the controller performs acquisition, revision resolution and identity recording. Return the selection through the controller protocol.

evidence_closure.objective: Follow open-kernel-driver-port/references/acquisition.md and handoff.md to choose the task-relevant evidence facets. This stage owns the material selection, rationale, source/provenance requirements and explicit gaps; the controller acquires content and records hashes and provenance. Do not use this stage for compiler/layout probes, C semantic closure, target API study, migration contracts, implementation or QEMU execution. Submit selections through the controller protocol and preserve valid selections on repair.

environment_recovery.objective: Follow open-kernel-driver-port/references/environment-recovery.md using frozen repositories and inventory.local_probes. This stage owns the artifact mode, executable experiment route and environment entrypoint; it does not perform target API study, source-contract design or driver implementation. Submit the environment report and entrypoint through the controller protocol.

target_platform_study.objective: Complete one evidence-backed source/target analysis and contract/test plan under analysis-task.md. Resolve design-changing unknowns, expose all required delivery entrypoints and preserve frozen scope. Submit one report; controller bookkeeping does not need another analysis task.

migration_contracts.objective: Complete or repair the current migration contracts and acceptance plan under analysis-task.md using the accepted source/target evidence. Focus on unresolved or contradicted claims and their dependents; do not repeat settled platform discovery.

target_framework_enablement.objective: Complete the first coherent delivery under delivery-task.md: necessary framework changes, driver implementation, runtime insertion, required testing interfaces, artifact and harness. Separate ledger checkpoints do not require separate model tasks. Resolve only actual capability gaps and verify the current required behavior.

driver_implementation.objective: Complete the required driver delivery under delivery-task.md. If this is a repair or continuation, preserve working code and resolve the cited defects or missing deliverables; do not restart the initial analysis or framework task. Keep the full frozen behavior and evidence obligations.

artifact_preparation.objective: Prepare and identify the runtime artifact under knowledge-guided-driver-port/references/qemu-evidence.md. Use the existing implementation, contracts and test plan. This stage owns packaging/injection, the presence checker and artifact identity; keep source changes limited to necessary packaging or integration wiring and route behavioral changes back to driver_implementation. Do not perform the public QEMU evidence ladder here. Submit through the controller protocol.

public_qemu_validation.objective: Consume the artifact and identity fixed by artifact_preparation and complete knowledge-guided-driver-port/references/workflow.md phase 8's public QEMU evidence ladder plus phase 9's narrow failure attribution under qemu-evidence.md. This stage owns the public runner, harness/oracles and interpretation of controller receipts; it does not rebuild or redesign the driver artifact on the normal path. Update the same report with each required result, attribution and limit, then complete the worker self-check. The independent final evidence audit is final_evidence_review, not a second artifact-preparation task.

final_evidence_review.objective: Independently perform knowledge-guided-driver-port/references/workflow.md phase 11 (Final evidence audit) over the current implementation, target changes, runtime artifact and public QEMU evidence. Treat the supplied contract and test-matrix digests as frozen acceptance oracles; do not re-review target study, handoff, source closure or contract provenance. Apply the final-evidence-review rules, cite precise code and authoritative execution evidence, and return all delivery findings together. Treat human-readable artifact receipts and worker summaries as derived metadata; a receipt-only mismatch is not a packaging defect and must not trigger artifact preparation or a new QEMU run. Accept only complete agreed functionality, otherwise request the smallest evidenced repair or report a genuine external blocker.

analysis_review.objective: Independently review the completed target-platform study, source analysis, migration contracts and test plan before implementation and before sealing the evidence/design phase. Apply the shared review rules. Verify key evidence locations and whether originals actually support core behavior, API availability/blocker claims, the concrete driver insertion boundary, the artifact identity path and existing test coverage. Use the read-only Python locator explicitly for source references. Check the intended target architecture/artifact route separately from any standalone QEMU model smoke; a model smoke is not proof that a migrated driver can enter the target artifact. Review all assigned materials, then return all findings together with precise report/source line references and reasons. Judge readiness for implementation; planned implementation and runtime tests are not missing analysis deliverables. Request the earliest affected permitted prerequisite for substantive defects; use BLOCKED only for a genuine external prerequisite or sealed premise.
